# Unsloth — training framework

- https://github.com/unslothai/unsloth — LB1's SFT framework (claims ~2× faster, ~70% less VRAM; supports SFT, LoRA, GRPO).
- Standard tooling, not a technique unique to LB1. Our pipeline historically used a CCE replay recipe (v14); Unsloth was planned (v12) but superseded.
